purpose: Discovery inventory for the Castr documentation and fidelity correction. Inclusion, tags and source relationships do not certify documentation or implementation correctness.

source.path_scope: Every recursive tracked blob at the base revision; index and working-tree changes are not substituted for baseline contents.
source.blob_hash: Git object ID supplied by ls-tree, not a separately computed content checksum.
source.inventory_self_inclusion: This new inventory is outside the baseline. Later additions and removals require a subsequent coverage reconciliation.

method.embedded_candidates: JavaScript/TypeScript-family source containing /** or a .description(, .option( or .addHelpText( call; JSON/TOML/YAML containing a description, instructions or prompt word.
method.generated: Only established reviewer, rule and skill adapter families are labelled generated; other generated-looking files remain undecided unless another discovery tag applies.
method.ordinary_undecided: No positive discovery signal matched; this is not a determination that the file contains no documentation.
method.source_paths: Established canonical/template/registration paths for generated adapters and resolved repository-relative symbolic-link targets, verified to exist at the same baseline; empty elsewhere means not established.
method.symbolic_links: Classify and hash the tracked link blob itself without dereferencing its content. Record its established target in source_paths; the target has its own inventory row.
method.counts: Tags can overlap. Counts describe discovery only. Archive, upstream and other lifecycle/provenance dispositions remain to be reviewed.
method.review_state: All entries start unreviewed with disposition outstanding; no absence of a finding or passing count constitutes correctness evidence.
method.review_records: Immutable CSV membership is separate from mutable reviews keyed by path here. Missing review inherits unreviewed/outstanding defaults; overrides require blob-bound evidence. Semicolon joins tag and source path arrays.

generation_sources.qualification: Fix mode creates missing Claude/Agents pointers; it does not establish bytewise freshness of all existing pointers.
Run the commands sequentially from the repository root. Canonical skill discovery is recursive.

coverage_check.qualification: This check establishes discovery coverage only.
